payload.claim: The fail-branch summary reads "{len(failures)} of {len(before)} collected tests not carried forward", but len(failures) now also counts rename-not-collected failures whose file (the declared new name) need not be, and need not even have been, a member of before. For example with base=[test_charlie] and renames={test_charlie: test_cherry_new} where test_charlie is still collected at head and test_cherry_new never appears, the gate reports "1 of 1 collected tests not carried forward" even though the one test collected at base was carried forward; the real problem is an undiscovered rename target, not a lost base test. No test asserts this summary string, so the mismatch between what the message claims and what the gate actually found is invisible to the suite.
